name: kanio-bets
description: KANIO - plateforme de paris sportifs virtuels (monnaie fictive, sans valeur reelle)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
